US.description: Covers groceries, utilities, transportation, and personal expenses for a single person.

IN.description: The cost of living excluding rent is relatively low, particularly for groceries, local transportation, and dining out. Imported goods and certain luxury services can be higher.

SG.description: High cost for groceries, dining out, and private transport; public transport is efficient and more affordable, contributing to overall high living expenses.

CH.description: Cost of living is exceptionally high, particularly for groceries, dining, transportation, and utilities across all major cities.

NL.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and general expenses; generally high

GB.description: High for groceries, utilities, and transport, particularly in London, but generally above average across the country.

CA.description: Includes groceries, utilities, local transportation, internet, phone, and modest entertainment costs for a single person.

AE.description: Cost of living excluding rent is high, driven by dining, entertainment, and certain imported goods, while utilities and transportation can be moderate.

NO.description: High cost for groceries, public transport, and dining out.

IE.description: High cost for groceries, utilities, transportation, and leisure activities, particularly in urban areas like Dublin.

LU.description: High cost of living for groceries, transportation, and dining, reflecting a generally expensive European capital.

AU.description: High cost, reflecting expenses for groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure for a single person.

QA.description: Cost of living is moderate, with groceries and transportation being relatively affordable, but dining out and certain leisure activities can be higher.

BN.description: Relatively affordable daily expenses including groceries, local transportation, utilities, and modest leisure activities.

MO.description: Cost of living is high in Macao, particularly for groceries, dining out, and imported goods due to limited local production and high demand.
